description: Every Core 2 enemy, reactions off and on (first, Auto, Back answers), classes and seeds rotating: a digest of each whole fight (a line per turn with pools and intents, offers, damage, event counts, RNG counters, a sha256 of the event order).

policyText.off: reactions off; play the first affordable non-reaction card at the first living enemy, End Turn
policyText.first: reactions on; hold trait:reaction cards, play the first affordable other card at the first living enemy, End Turn; answer every offer with its first option
policyText.decline: reactions on; hold trait:reaction cards, play the first affordable other card at the first living enemy, End Turn; answer every offer Back
policyText.auto: reactions on; hold trait:reaction cards, play the first affordable other card at the first living enemy, End Turn; Auto answers every offer (chooseReaction)
